india_trends.title: Bank unions announce strikes on September 11 over unresolved issues
india_trends.summary: The United Forum of Bank Unions (UFBU), representing over 90% of India’s banking workforce, has announced strikes on September 11 and September 28-30, followed by an indefinite strike from October 26 if its demands are not resolved.

india_trends.title: TVS Motor sales rise 21% to 6.16 lakh units in August
india_trends.summary: TVS Motor Company’s total sales rose 21% year-on-year to 6.17 lakh units in August 2026. Two-wheeler EV sales surged 137% to 59,453 units, while international sales grew 29% and three-wheeler sales increased 34%.

india_trends.title: HDFC Bank’s Jagdishan paradox: Stock lagged even as domestic funds doubled down
india_trends.summary: HDFC Bank stock returned just 17% under the outgoing CEO, trailing peers significantly, yet domestic institutions accumulated shares aggressively as post-merger adjustments reshaped the lender’s ownership.

india_trends.title: Global Market: European shares muted as bond yields surge on inflation concerns
india_trends.summary: European shares were largely flat on Tuesday as a sharp rise in government bond yields kept investors cautious amid renewed inflation concerns. The STOXX 600 edged up 0.04%, while energy stocks gained 1.4% as Brent crude traded near $92 a barrel.
